items.sm: Asks the Administration, in negotiations to renew the 1999 City-Cincinnati Public Schools agreement, not to count State of Ohio revenues diverted to charter schools in the "hold harmless" calculation.

items.t: Ask the Administration to negotiate a three-month extension of tax abatement provisions with Cincinnati Public Schools
items.sm: Asks the Administration to negotiate an extension through March 31, 2020 of the 1999 Agreement's tax abatement provisions with Cincinnati Public Schools while a new agreement is drafted.
